title: 용기 라벨 읽기: 전자레인지에 넣어도 돼요?
objective: By the end, you can read a food container label and find out which parts can go in the microwave, how hot they can get, and what you must not do.
summary: Learn to read the microwave information printed on food containers in Korea.
note: The brand name and numbers on this label are examples only.

task.title: Read the container labels
task.line: Use the label words on page 1 to answer each question.

sections.heading: Read the label
paragraphs:
두루 보관 용기 1000mL
내열 온도: 몸체 120℃ / 뚜껑 70℃
전자레인지: 몸체 사용 가능 / 뚜껑 사용 불가
주의: 전자레인지에 넣을 때 뚜껑을 빼세요. 직화·오븐 사용 금지.
Tip: Labels often list the body (몸체) and the lid (뚜껑) separately. Check each part. 가능 means OK. 불가 and 금지 both mean you must not do it.

items.text: You may use the container this way.
You must not use the container this way.
This also means you must not do it. It is often used for rules about danger.
This is the part of the container that holds the food.
It covers the top of the container.
This is the highest temperature the part can take.
It tells you what the container is made of.
This means putting the container right on a gas fire.
Read this part carefully before you use the container.
This means making cold food warm.

sections.heading: Using the container in the microwave

exercises: Look at the label on page 1 and answer: Which part can go in the microwave, 몸체 or 뚜껑?
Read each label and write 가능 (OK) or 불가 (not OK) for the microwave: ① 몸체 사용 가능 ② 뚜껑 사용 불가 ③ 뚜껑 사용 금지
Do not use the label on page 1 for this question. Read only the label given here and answer with a number. What is the heat limit of the lid?: 내열 온도: 몸체 140℃ / 뚜껑 80℃
Fill in the blank with the right form of 빼다 (~고) (from the 주의 line on page 1): 이 용기 뚜껑은 '사용 불가'예요. 뚜껑을 ____ 데우세요.
Choose the right word: 가스 불 위에 올리면 안 돼요. 라벨에 '직화 (가능 / 금지)'라고 쓰여 있어요.
Put the steps in order, following the steps in the last section: 데우기 / 조심해서 꺼내기 / 뚜껑 열기 / 라벨 확인하기
answers: ① 가능 ② 불가 ③ 불가
라벨 확인하기 → 뚜껑 열기 → 데우기 → 조심해서 꺼내기
